notes.title: UPDATE 1.01
notes.content:
* fixed an issue with videos not showing up on various screen panels
* Fixed an issue with flashlights not illuminating in certain spots.
* Fixed an issue with doors opening even without the player near them
* A bunch of graphical and minor adjustments

notes.title: WE ARE ACTIVELY LOOKING FOR STEAM CURATORS OF ALL TYPES
notes.content: If you are a curator and are interested in providing the game with some much-needed publicity and a genuine review please email us via our business email on stream, we will reply as soon as we can, thank you!
